name: dynamic-form-autofill
description: Upload any form (PDF/image) -> Gemini vision analysis -> dynamic JSON schema -> editable form auto-filled from conversation.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace web"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace shared && npm run test --workspace server
